study: Fong et al. 2015, Expository Reading and Writing Course (ERWC), WestEd i3
delivery_evidence: ERWC professional learning = a two-day summer professional-learning session + professional learning community (PLC) meetings + coaching sessions (Ch.2 ERWC Professional Learning, p.12). Face-to-face.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome = CSU English Placement Test (EPT) total scale score, administered/scored by ETS, a broad independent placement test not tailored to ERWC (Table 3.4-3.5, p.26).
curriculum_evidence: ERWC is a grade-12 English course with its own curriculum and materials package ('ERWC Curriculum' and 'ERWC Materials' sections; each of the 56 study teachers received all the materials); PD tied to adopting the ERWC course (Ch.2, pp.9-13).
outcome_timing_evidence: EPT measured spring 2014, end of the 2013/14 school year / end of the intervention course (Table 3.4, p.26; design).
